Bubba Wallace is an American professional stock car racing driver who competes in the NASCAR Cup Series. Over the years, he has been involved in several controversies and conspiracy theories. One of the most widely publicized incidents occurred in June 2020 when a noose was found in his garage stall at Talladega Superspeedway. The incident led to an FBI investigation, which concluded that the noose had been there since October 2019 and was not a hate crime directed at Wallace. This sparked considerable public debate and conspiracy theories, including discussions on whether the incident was staged or a misunderstanding.

Another controversy involved Wallace's advocacy for the Black Lives Matter movement, which garnered polarized reactions from both supporters and critics within the racing community and the general public. Wallace's stance on various social justice issues has made him a significant figure in discussions about diversity and inclusion in NASCAR. Despite these controversies, Wallace continues to be an influential presence in the sport.
